rows.grounds: Locative plural of saṅgrāma, denoting places of battle.
Genitive plural of nadī with enclitic ca; sandhi fusion marked in the token.
Locative plural of sāgara, denoting ocean locations.
Enclitic conjunction adding to the list of locations.
Locative plural numeral; commonly qualifies the seven oceans or rivers in such enumerations.

items.question: Which further locations, including battles, rivers, and the seven oceans, are enumerated as suitable sites?
premises: Battles are included among the enumerated locations.
Rivers are included among the enumerated locations.
The seven oceans are included among the enumerated locations.
items.inference: The enumeration extends the list of suitable sites to battles, rivers, and the seven oceans.
uncertainties: The exact referent qualified by saptasu is not explicit within this verse alone, though it commonly refers to the seven oceans.
items.plain_english: In battles, at rivers, and in the seven oceans as well.
